hypotheses.construction_plan: Start with an unordered two-element multiset {A(x), B(x)} under commutative addition. The identity realization writes A(x)+B(x), giving F(z)+G(z) after A=F, B=G, x=z. The permute realization swaps the two multiset entries, giving B(x)+A(x), i.e. G(z)+F(z).
required_assumptions: Addition of symbolic terms is commutative.
F and G are independent opaque unary function symbols.
hypotheses.rationale: The observed structural relation is algebraic commutativity of addition, so the sum of two evaluated unary functions is invariant under S2 permutation of its two summands.

hypotheses.construction_plan: Define a two-function template H(A,B;x)=A(x)+B(x). Specialize the function parameters and argument to (F,G,z) for the given expression and to (G,F,z) for the commuted expression.
required_assumptions: F and G may be treated as parameters of the template.
The template is symmetric in A and B only through commutation of addition.
hypotheses.rationale: The expression is an instance of a general sum of two unary function calls sharing the same argument, with function heads as parameters.
